title: [Cu<sub>36</sub>I<sub>56</sub>]<sup>20⊖</sup>—a Novel Polyanion in the Compound (pyH)<sub>2</sub>[Cu<sub>3</sub>I<sub>5</sub>]
abstract: The largest discrete iodocuprate(I) ion observed so far has been identified in the compound (pyH)2[Cu3I5]. 36 CuI tetrahedra are linked through common edges to form a highly symmetrical polyanion [Cu36I56]20⊖ with the extremely rare symmetry 432 (O).
